brief.symptoms: The offset manager commits offsets out of order, causing the committed offset to be higher than the offset included in the request.
brief.evidence: out of order commit to partition 0, current committed offset: 7, offset in request: 1
hints: The offset commit request is being processed while other requests are queued.
Look at the offset manager's coordination with the broker.
When multiple commit requests arrive simultaneously, the broker may handle them in a different order than they were queued.
brief.lesson: The fix adds a lock around the offset commit request to ensure that the broker processes each request in the order it was received, preventing out-of-order commits.
